:::{#def-objective-function}
#### Objective function

An **objective function** $\objfn$ is a rule that gives each member $\modmem$ of a [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$
a number computed from a [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$,
where a smaller number means a better fit to the data:

$$
\modmem \mapsto \objfnf{\modmem; \dataset}, \quad \modmem \in \modelfam.
$$ {#eq-objective-function}

:::
